Ever wondered about the true origins of the holidays we celebrate today? In this video, we dive deep into the often-hidden, pagan roots of popular holidays like Valentine's Day, St. Patrick's Day, and Easter—along with others you may have never even heard of! Discover how ancient traditions and rituals have shaped modern celebrations in ways that might surprise you. This is the first episode of a 3-part series where we uncover the truth behind these holidays, exposing their hidden meanings and influences.

Stay tuned for Parts 2 and 3, where we’ll continue our exploration of history, symbolism, and spiritual significance! Don't forget to like, subscribe, and share if you want to know the Candid Truth behind the holidays.
